title: Verified release assets and post-publication cleanup declaration
description: No calendar schedule. Cleanup runs only after this exact public GitHub release/tag/commit and every actual resource download pass verification. Current accepted assets, sources and audits are preserved.

assets.description: All resources required to call this version published. URL must be the exact GitHub release download URL for repository/tag/name; local and streamed remote bytes and SHA256 must match.

accepted_manifests.description: Current accepted delivery/source manifests, pinned by hash. Their existing local path reference closure is automatically protected, including entire source/processed directories.

keep_paths.description: Additional current version files/directories, including a new version still awaiting insertion into a delivery manifest. Never list the project root.

obsolete_versions.description: Explicitly reviewed prior-version cache roots. Not age based. Their source/audit/non-binary files remain even when binary caches are removed. Current version ID is forbidden.

relative_path.description: Literal slash-separated path under the project; no absolute path, colon, dot traversal, wildcard, symlink or junction.
